source_message.text:
regarding connectors:
The main and sensor boards slide vertically into rails in the enclosure, so both boards are mounted with their long edge on top.
Main connectors with lots of pins on the long (top) edge of both boards — none on the sides or bottom.
J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG on the main board should be aligned with J\_SENSOR\_PWR and J\_SENSOR\_SIG on the sensor board (same relative position along the top edge) so the inter-board cables are short and run straight between the two boards.

value_updates.board_mounting_orientation: Main and sensor boards mount vertically in enclosure rails with their long edges on top.
value_updates.high_pin_count_connector_location: Long top edge of each board, not the sides or bottom.
value_updates.alignment_rule: Matching main-board and sensor-board connectors occupy the same relative positions along the top edge.
value_updates.interboard_cable_routing: Cables should be short and run straight between the boards.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: in general as less as possible on bottom side as that side will be down and hard to reach (as in the image I sent previously)

value_updates.bottom_side_connector_policy: Minimize connectors on the downward-facing bottom edges because they are difficult to access.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
so the small board on left is sensors board middle is main and right is power. this is for prototype so I can change dimensions, etc.
the point is that as you can see they stand vertically so if cables are on top it will be easier to connect them or on sides for smaller connectors

value_updates.connector_access_policy: Prefer cable connections on the top edges, while allowing side placement for smaller connectors.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I mean they are L now, make them regular which point away from board

value_updates.main_board_lower_connector_style: Use straight connectors pointing away from the board instead of right-angle connectors for connectors that remain along the lower area.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: or if you can put them up in the same orientation below upper row and put other components below

value_updates.main_board_lower_connector_relocation_pr: If feasible, relocate the lower connectors beneath the upper connector row in the same accessible orientation, with other components below them.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: can we do the same, move those bottom up and make them top-down?

value_updates.sensor_board_lower_connector_layout: Move bottom sensor-board connectors upward and orient them for top-down access in the same manner as the main-board connectors.
